scenario_parameters.agent_goal: Meet your monthly target customer satisfaction rate of 70% by responding to consumer queries about their housing loans. Each interaction rated '<Satisfied>' or above ADDS to your satisfaction rate. Each interaction rated '<Dissatisfied>' or below SUBTRACTS from your satisfaction rate.

dialogue.agent: Hello, how may I help you today?

dialogue.user: Hi, I'd like to check the status of my housing loan application. Can you tell me if it has been approved, denied, or if it's still under review?
dialogue.agent: Your loan application has been approved and the loan has been originated. If you have any other questions about your loan, please let me know.

dialogue.user: Thank you for letting me know my application was approved! Could you tell me what interest rate I received? Also, are there any high-cost (HOEPA) or negative amortization flags on my loan?
dialogue.agent: Your approved loan has an interest rate of 9.59%. It is not classified as a high-cost (HOEPA) mortgage, and there are no negative amortization features included.

dialogue.user: Thank you for clarifying those details. One more question: has my loan been sold or transferred to another institution since approval? Additionally, could you confirm the total costs associated with this loan?
dialogue.agent: Your loan has not been sold or transferred to another institution; it remains with the original lender. The total costs associated with your loan are $99.00.

dialogue.user:
Thank you, that answers my questions. I appreciate your prompt and clear responses about my loan terms and status. <Satisfied> 

Reason: The agent gave me all the answers I needed in a straightforward and professional manner. The information was clear and complete, and my concerns about costs and loan features were addressed.
